answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can submit a claim, and let independent reviewers slash the bond when they prove duplicate identities or fabricated work. A Sybil attacker can still create many accounts, but each one needs capital locked up, and a successful challenge destroys part of it; scaling the attack therefore raises its cost rather than merely multiplying usernames. Set the bond at the inlet to participation, review challenges over a fixed horizon, and release valid bonds at dawn after disputes close.
